name: Puri
confidence_why: The only statement on Puri accent, Loukotka 1937, was compiled from nineteenth-century wordlists and calls its own probable-penultimate (sometimes final) reading hypothetical with all the data doubtful, while Martius 1867, Ehrenreich 1886 and Torrezão 1889 mark accents on single words without stating any rule, so any placement is a guess.
catalog_citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1937. La familia lingüística coroado. Journal de la Société des Américanistes 29(1): 157-214. doi:10.3406/jsa.1937.1952
catalog_locator: Section 'Fonética', pp.161-162; the accent statement is the first paragraph of p.162
catalog_quote: Todo lo referido aquí en cuanto a la fonética y acentuación tiene por consiguiente un carácter hipotético. No es posible establecer una regla general para la acentuación en los idiomas de esta familia, parece probable que el acento tónico racae sobre la penúltima sílaba y en ciertos casos sobre la última. Resulta también muy difícil decidir si una vocal se breve o larga. Todos nuestros datos al respecto son dudosos.
world_status: statement found in an open source

No es posible establecer una regla general para la acentuación en los idiomas de esta familia, parece probable que el acento tónico racae [sic] sobre la penúltima sílaba y en ciertos casos sobre la última. Resulta también muy difícil decidir si una vocal se [sic] breve o larga. Todos nuestros datos al respecto son dudosos.
new_statements.translation: Everything stated here about phonetics and accentuation is consequently hypothetical in character. It is not possible to establish a general rule for accentuation in the languages of this family; it seems probable that the tonic accent falls on the penultimate syllable and in certain cases on the last. It is also very difficult to decide whether a vowel is short or long. All our data in this respect are doubtful.

Locator holds: printed p.162 = PDF page 7, top of page, immediately continuing the 'Fonética' section that begins on p.161 (p.6). I read the text ( lines 205-236) and rendered PDF page 7 at 150 dpi and inspected the image: the passage reads exactly 'Todo lo referido aquí en cuanto a la fonética y acentuación tiene por consiguiente un carácter hipotético. No es posible establecer una regla general para la acentuación en los idiomas de esta familia, parece probable que el acento tónico racae sobre la penúltima sílaba y en ciertos casos sobre la última. Resulta también muy difícil decid…
new_statements.rule_in_words: For the Puri-Coroado family as a whole (Coroado, Puri, Koropó), judged from accent marks in 19th-century wordlists: stress probably penultimate, with some words final-stressed; the author states no firm rule can be given and the whole account is hypothetical.
new_statements.exceptions: 'en ciertos casos sobre la última' — some words with final stress (consistent with Torrezão 1889's accent marks, e.g. nguê 'cabeça', kandú, chambé alongside tembóra, capôna).
new_statements.domain_note: Isolated citation forms in old wordlists (Eschwege, Martius, Balbi, Noronha Torrezão for Puri); family-level generalisation, not Puri-specific; no phrase-level data; preceded (p.161) by the caveat that none of the vocabularies was recorded 'según las normas de la fonética moderna'.
new_statements.identity_note: Loukotka's statement is made for the whole 'familia coroado' (Coroado, Puri, Koropó) collectively, from philological analysis of 19th-c. wordlists (Puri sources P1-P4 = Eschwege, Martius, Balbi, Noronha Torrezão), not from fieldwork on Puri alone; he flags it as hypothetical. Glottolog treats Puri (puri1262) and Coroado (coro1249) as separate languages of the Puri-Coroado family; Métraux 1946 calls Puri 'a dialect of Coroado'. The modern 'Kwaytikindo' revitalised Puri (2020-) is a reconstructed variety and was not accessed.

tone.quote: Relata que os vocabulários, além de antigos, não foram estabelecidos de acordo com as normas da fonética moderna. Sendo totalmente impossível determinar o som e a articulação das vogais e das consoantes. Portanto, tudo o que se refere em termos de fonética e acentuação tem um caráter hipotético. Loukotka não viu possibilidade de estabelecer uma regra geral de acentuação nas línguas da família. Aponta a probabilidade que o acento tônico recaia na penúltima sílaba e em certos casos na última. Tem dificuldade de decidir quando uma vogal é curta ou longa e finaliza afirmando que todos os dados são duvidosos.
tone.locator: p. 111, section 3.3.1 'Características das línguas da família Pury'
tone.translation: He reports that the vocabularies, besides being old, were not established according to the norms of modern phonetics, it being totally impossible to determine the sound and articulation of the vowels and consonants. Hence everything said about phonetics and accentuation is hypothetical. Loukotka saw no possibility of establishing a general accentuation rule for the languages of the family. He points to the probability that the tonic accent falls on the penultimate syllable and in certain cases on the last. He finds it difficult to decide when a vowel is short or long and ends by stating that all the data are doubtful.
